- Added a "Upgrade to Premium Clinical Pilot" section, detailing premium features such as additional clinical safety rules, insurance verification, real-time sync, and emergency triage protocols.

Initial release of Medical & Dental Appointment Pilot (HIPAA Grounded):

- Supports high-trust, HIPAA-aware appointment handling for medical and dental clinics.
- Uses ThumbGate to prevent scheduling errors and ensure practitioner specialty matching.
- Real-time sync to avoid double-booking; integrates with Google Sheets or API.
- Screens insurance providers before allowing appointment confirmation.
- Enforces privacy and safety through strict data handling and emergency rules.
